settings.html: <style>@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Lato:wght@300;400;700&display=swap'); .blog-cat-wrapper { border-top: 1px solid rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.1); padding: 16px 24px; position: sticky; top: 64px; z-index: 20; background-color: #FFFFFF; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .blog-cat-container { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; overflow-x: auto; -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; } .blog-cat-container::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .blog-cat-btn { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important; font-size: 12px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .blog-cat-btn.active { background-color: #688F9D; color: #FFFFFF !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(104, 143, 157, 0.2), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(104, 143, 157, 0.1); } .blog-cat-btn:not(.active) { background-color: transparent; color: rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.6) !important; } .blog-cat-btn:not(.active):hover { color: #0E1B30 !important; background-color: rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.1); }</style>
